purpose: One offline fixed-budget reservoir equilibrium correction, R36; no new sensing
objective: Mean squared preservation of parent dynamic logits on original training histories plus equally weighted mean squared VMC equilibrium logits error plus ridge .001 on feature-normalized linear correction; six independent solves
scope: Frozen 128 reservoir, nonlinear readout, output gain .5 and proprio48/action7. Change signed-axis linear readout only. No simulation truth, stage, scene, event time or withheld layouts. Training history is the original R33 set, not observer-scale failures. Interpolation checks are development probes, not blind robot tests.
budget: One closed-form candidate, no ridge/weight sweep. Only if offline criteria pass, at most six original declared development regression episodes at original observer scale .005. Full raw failures retained. No first-impact safety improvement claimed.
